measured_commit_note: Every count below was recorded on measured_commit and describes that commit only. It predates the null-key fix, so it does not cover the membership tests added after it; see addendum_after_measured_commit.

addendum_after_measured_commit.change: JSON null inner/probe keys stay on the hash route via one hasNull flag on the Keys record instead of returning Keys.FALLBACK.
addendum_after_measured_commit.authoritative_run: This pipeline's test step, not the campaign counts below.

plan_shape_change.change: The lookup is no longer bound by a generated let clause; it is nested inside the probe, so it occupies no pipeline tuple slot. A spilling group by serialized that slot and failed the query with bit:BIDY0005.
plan_shape_change.timings_affected: YES. The recorded Q12 seconds and the t100k/t250k after-plan trees describe the superseded plan. Q12 must be re-measured at t100k before the done-bar claim is re-asserted; that re-measurement was NOT performed in this round (tier inputs, oracles and store live at caller-owned scratch paths this record does not pin down).
plan_shape_change.expected_but_unverified: One build per enclosing binding is retained and the work-bound tests still pin linear inner-input visits, so the order-of-growth conclusion is expected to hold. Absolute seconds at HEAD are unverified.

addendum_after_measured_commit.timings_unaffected_by_the_null_key_fix: The SH1 Q12 keys are contract ids with no null among them, so the null-key fix alone leaves the recorded route and order-of-growth conclusion unchanged. See plan_shape_change for the later change that does invalidate the recorded seconds.
